|descr= <pre>/*

		ARRAY in format [allscannames, activeareaboundaries]
		
	Example:
		"MyScan" call BIN_fnc_getTXScanSaveData
		"" call BIN_fnc_getTXScanSaveData
*/

#define IDD_DEFAULT 12
#define IDC_DEFAULT 51
